_owner_decisions.decision: Statutory filings (federal and state) go through a third-party filing provider; no ADP integration (owner, biweekly 2026-10-21). Provider choice is a business decision outside the build (2026-10-29). SIR = provider-agnostic hand-off: Mercans produces provider input; the employer keeps liability.

_scope_note: Unit third_party_provider_handoff: what each authority receives, on which channel, under which agent authorisation, and what a provider must be given. Mercans does not submit to authorities.

_facts_blocked_by_register_id_pattern._why: facts.schema.json 1.4.0 register_id pattern ^[A-Z]{2}-[A-Z0-9]{2,12}-[0-9]{3,4}$ rejects the multi-segment ids this build issued (e.g. US-FED-P5-1-002, US-MD-P5-1-005). The rows are active and the facts are sound; they are parked here, outside the validated array, until the orchestrator either loosens the pattern (PATCH bump: looser pattern) or the merge worker issues pattern-compliant alias ids. Builders may read them; QA P2 must treat them as bound to the named register row.
